caveats:
- converted windspeed vector input layer to raster in QGIS
- used 'Zonal statistics' in QGIS to compute average windspeed per adm3-area
- computed 1-10 scores for both rain and windspeed by transforming the min-max range linearly to a 1-10 range (simply computed manually in Attribute Table) and averaged them (with equal weights) to a composite score.
name: haiti-hurricane-matthew-composite-index-hurricane-impact-wind-rain
notes:
Includes the windspeed per adm3-area, and a combined 1-10 score for windspeed and accumulated rainfall.

Datasets used:

- https://data.humdata.org/dataset/accumulated-gpm-imerg-data-for-haiti-hurricane-matthew-october-3-6th-2016

- https://data.humdata.org/dataset/hurricane-matthew-gust-footprint-tropical-storm-risk-university-college-london
